breve: A physics joint that attaches two 3D physics bodies at a single point, allowing them to freely rotate.
descricao: A physics joint that attaches two 3D physics bodies at a single point, allowing them to freely rotate. For example, a RigidBody3D can be attached to a StaticBody3D to create a pendulum or a seesaw.

metodos.desc: Returns the value of the specified parameter.
Sets the value of the specified parameter.

propriedades.desc: The force with which the pinned objects stay in positional relation to each other. The higher, the stronger.
The force with which the pinned objects stay in velocity relation to each other. The higher, the stronger.
If above 0, this value is the maximum value for an impulse that this Joint3D produces.

constantes.desc: The force with which the pinned objects stay in positional relation to each other. The higher, the stronger.
